display.purpose: The landing headline, the customiser title, the 404.

headline.purpose: A landing section's heading under its eyebrow.

lede.purpose: The sentence under a heading, in muted ink.

label.purpose: The eyebrow and group names, always uppercase and tracked.

code.purpose: Code blocks, inline code, the preset code.

shadows.name: amber-glow
shadows.purpose: The primary pill on hover; the only glow.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: A section lifting into place as it enters; gone under reduced motion.

motion.name: phone-settle
motion.purpose: The hero phone from rotate(2deg) scale(0.95) to flat on hover.

mixes.name: --pill
mixes.purpose: The nav pill's fill; 70% in dark.

mixes.name: --shadow
mixes.purpose: Light: a darkening. Dark: 80% of the page, so it never halos.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The one amber call to action on a page.
components.css: .ds-pill-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); color: var(--color-fd-primary-foreground, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms, filter 150ms; } .ds-pill-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)) 28%, transparent); filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-pill-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill
components.description: The second action beside the amber one.
components.css: .ds-pill-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-fd-border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fd-card, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-fd-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-pill-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-fd-accent, oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033)); } .ds-pill-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: The studio's section marker: a 6px amber dot and a tracked label.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font: 500 13px/16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-fd-muted-foreground, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); } .ds-eyebrow-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A showcase or index tile: surface, hairline, house card radius, no shadow.
components.html: ButtonA pressable action, with composed icons and a loading state that costs no layout.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: calc(0.45rem * 1.8); border: 1px solid var(--color-fd-border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); background: var(--color-fd-card, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)); color: var(--color-fd-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-card-stage { display: block; height: 160px; background: var(--color-capture, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-card-caption { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-fd-border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); } .ds-card-name { font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-blurb { font: 400 12px/16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-fd-muted-foreground, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); }

components.name: Pill Nav
components.description: The floating, blurred, shrink-wrapped navigation bar.
components.html: Delacour UIDocsComponentsChartsTheme
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 48px; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-fd-border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fd-card, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885)) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fd-background, oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-nav-title { margin-right: 20px; font: 600 16px/20px Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-fd-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-fd-muted-foreground, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-fd-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); }

components.name: Preset Tile
components.description: A customiser option: a hairline tile that rings in amber when selected.
components.html: DelacourThe studio's own: zinc, amber, Inter and Outfit.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: calc(0.45rem * 1.4); border: 1px solid var(--color-fd-border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); color: var(--color-fd-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tile:hover { background: var(--color-fd-accent, oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033)); } .ds-tile-selected { border-color: var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); } .ds-tile-disc { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-fd-primary, oklch(0.837 0.164 84.429)); } .ds-tile-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-tile-title { font: 500 14px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile-blurb { font: 400 12px/16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-fd-muted-foreground, oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067)); }

narrative.overview: The documentation site is delacour.co.nz carried into the library it sells. One near-black ground with a faint field of dots under everything, zinc surfaces a shade above it, hairlines a shade above those, and a single amber that is spent only on what a reader can act on or must notice. The page is one reading column: thirty-six rem of Inter, top to bottom, with Outfit at 600 set tight for every heading. Every colour on the site is resolveTokens(HOUSE_CONFIG), the customiser's own house preset, generated into house.css — the theme you build at /theme is the theme this page is wearing.
keyCharacteristics: Dark first; light is the same system with the roles swapped, never a second design.
One accent, amber, spent on interactives and markers only.
One column of 36rem for prose; the page widens only for a picture wall or an index.
Outfit 600, tracked −0.025em, for every heading; Inter body at 16/26; Geist Mono for code.
8px corners at the control, 1.8× that for a card, fully round for a pill.
A faint dot field is the only material; depth is a hairline or an offset shadow, never both.
One motion: the scroll reveal. No scattered hover effects.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks what a reader can do or must notice — an action, an active state, a marker — and nothing else. No amber band, no amber heading, no amber card.

rules.name: The Mixed-Not-Typed Rule
rules.body: A colour the axes cannot name (--dot, --pill, --glow, --shadow, --selection) is a color-mix() of a --color-fd-* token. app.css carries no hex and no oklch() of its own; the test fails if one appears.

rules.name: The Capture Rule
rules.body: A photographed preview sits on bg-capture, never on the page colour.

rules.name: The Heading Face Rule
rules.body: h1–h4 are Outfit 600, tracked −0.025em and balanced, by one base rule in app.css; no element re-declares a heading face.

rules.name: The Line-Height Rule
rules.body: Every px type step carries its own line height (--text-*--line-height) so a size never inherits its parent's ratio.

rules.name: The Border-or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card has a hairline and no shadow. Only the two floating objects — the phone and the nav — carry a shadow, and they carry it with a real offset.

rules.name: The Dot Field Rule
rules.body: The ground is a 28px dot grid of --dot (9% of the foreground in light, 7% in dark) on body. It is the site's one texture and belongs to every route; nothing else is laid over the page.

dos: Do take every colour from house.css (--color-fd-*) or a color-mix() of one; regenerate with bun run gen-theme when the house preset moves.
Do set every heading in Outfit 600, tracked −0.025em, and every code span in Geist Mono.
Do keep prose in the 36rem column and separate sections with py-section, never with a rule or a tinted band.
Do round a card at rounded-card, a tile at rounded-tile, a control at rounded-control and a call to action fully; keep every border at 1px.
Do put a captured preview on bg-capture.
Do precede a section heading with the eyebrow (dot + tracked label) on the landing page and the component index, and nowhere in docs prose.
Do carry a shadow only with an offset and a blur, and only under something that floats.
donts: Don't type a hex or an oklch() in app.css or a component; the parity test fails on one.
Don't add a second accent, an amber background band or gradient text.
Don't put a glow behind the hero or a grid over the ground; the dot field is the only texture.
Don't nest a card in a card, or add a shadow to a card that already has a hairline.
Don't add a hover effect that moves, tilts or scales anything other than the hero phone; the reveal is the site's one motion.
Don't restyle Fumadocs by replacing its structure; theme it through its variables and rules scoped to #nd-* ids.
Don't reword landing copy without updating components/landing/copy.test.ts; the strings are held verbatim.
